name: A2 Ultra
summary: AgiBot A2 Ultra is a full-size humanoid robot from AgiBot. AgiBot states it has been deployed commercially at scale, with over a thousand units in real-world operations and use at over 20 enterprises.
specs_note: Commercial maturity COMMERCIAL recorded 2026-10-04 (owner decision, six-robot review). Identity: this record is the A2 Ultra model only; the former generic "A2" record was remediated (A2 Ultra and A2 Lite are separate products). Specifications not yet verified.

commercial_status_evidence.source_title: AGIBOT A2 Ultra — official product page
commercial_status_evidence.excerpt: AGIBOT A2 Ultra has delivered rock‑solid reliability and stability, proven through the deployment of over a thousand units in real‑world operations.
commercial_status_evidence.note: RETRIEVAL: AGENT_ASSISTED_RESEARCH (docs/26) — retrieved 2026-10-04 by Claude in a session initiated by Robert Konecny, under the owner WorkOrder implementing the six-robot commercial-status review decisions (2026-10-04). Not a MANUAL_BOOTSTRAP reading; not human-verified. A2 Ultra-specific first-party statement of deployment of over a thousand units in real-world operations. Applies to A2 Ultra only; nothing is transferred to A2 Lite.

commercial_status_evidence.excerpt: AGIBOT A2 Ultra is the industry's first full-sized humanoid robot deployed commercially at scale. With 4 major international certifications (CR, CE-MD, CE-RED, FCC), it has been applied in over 20 leading enterprises.
commercial_status_evidence.note: RETRIEVAL: AGENT_ASSISTED_RESEARCH (docs/26) — retrieved 2026-10-04 by Claude in a session initiated by Robert Konecny, under the owner WorkOrder implementing the six-robot commercial-status review decisions (2026-10-04). Not a MANUAL_BOOTSTRAP reading; not human-verified. Official store listing tagged 'inquiry-only' (published 2025-10-30). The listed price 999999 is a placeholder, not a price, and is not recorded. Purchase mechanism is not inferred.

pricing_offers.price_basis: Distributor weekly rental rate per unit, net of VAT and shipping (VAT treatment confirmed in the quotation; reverse charge for VAT-registered businesses in another member state)
pricing_offers.shipping_terms: Net of shipping and transport; quoted with the rental quotation
pricing_offers.note: Robotoplus published weekly rental rate for 'A2 Ultra' (6,500 EUR per week). Rental rate only: NO purchase price is published, so none is recorded (UNKNOWN). Region BG per the appointed-distributor wording.

evidence.excerpt: AGIBOT A2 Ultra — 'Rental unit in stock'; 'A2 Ultra, 6,500 EUR per week.' Weekly rates per unit, net of VAT and shipping.
